events.text: Your horse stance has lasted an hour today without shaking. A year ago it was ten breaths.

effects.log: Your legs are iron and jelly at once.
Pride is fuel too.

events.text: A training partner lands a clean blow on your ribs. It is the first time you feel how fragile you are.

effects.log: Your guard is never lazy again.
Iron shirt drills, every morning.

events.text: You learn to count your breaths to a thousand without losing your place.

effects.log: The count becomes a river.
Something opens.

events.text: You break your practice staff in a single strike.

effects.log: You break that one too, a month later.
Power you cannot aim is only noise.

events.text: A senior martial artist watches you and says: 'You fight with your arms. Fight with your feet.'

effects.log: Your footwork doubles your reach.
You lose the argument and the next spar.

events.text: During meditation your internal energy flickers like a candle in the wind.

effects.log: The flame grows still.
It flares, then settles. Your chest aches.

events.text: You cannot sleep, so you practise forms under the moon.

effects.log: Tired but sharper.

choices.text: Practise one form a hundred times

effects.log: One form, perfected.

events.text: You build a wooden training dummy with arms that swing back.

effects.log: It hits you back less each week.

choices.text: Give it a name and a hat

effects.log: Old Wooden Wang becomes your best sparring partner.

events.text: An old stone lifting ring sits at the edge of the training ground. Nobody your age can lift it.

ok.log: You lift it above your head. The yard goes quiet.

effects.log: Patience.

events.text: You send your qi down the wrong meridian by mistake. Your left arm goes numb.

effects.log: Feeling returns by morning.
Three days of eating with your right hand.

events.text: Your sword hums faintly when you draw it, as if answering your qi.

effects.log: Sword and self draw a little closer.
It hums every time now.

events.text: In a spar, you strike before you decide to strike. Your body knew first.

effects.log: Thinking less, knowing more.
A body that acts alone can make mistakes.

events.text: People on the road step aside when you pass. You have not drawn your sword in months.

effects.log: A quiet greatness.

choices.text: Tell them there is no need

effects.log: They step aside anyway.

events.text: You find you can keep the rain off your shoulders with a thin layer of qi.

effects.log: Villagers stare. Children follow.
It costs you nothing now.

events.text: Young fighters seek you out to test themselves. Three this month.

effects.log: They leave beaten and better.
Your peace is your own.

events.text: You stand on a floating leaf in a pond for a whole breath.

effects.log: You fall in. Then you do it.
Some tricks are better secret.

events.text: You sit so still in meditation that a sparrow lands on your knee.

effects.log: It stays an hour. You gain more than it does.
It flies away. You smile anyway.

events.text: An old injury aches when your qi runs through it.

effects.log: A month of patience. The ache is gone.
It aches every winter.

events.text: Your palm strike leaves a print in a stone wall. You did not mean to.

effects.log: He charges double to keep the print as an attraction. (−5 taels)
Control is harder than power.

events.text: For a moment, the edge of your sword seems to reach beyond the blade.

effects.log: Sword intent, a thread of it.

choices.text: Let it come in its own time

effects.log: It returns, stronger, in a year.

events.text: Your footsteps have stopped making sound. You notice it only when a cat jumps in surprise.

effects.log: Even the cat forgives you.
Politeness requires sound.

events.text: You breathe in and the whole mountain seems to breathe with you.

effects.log: Hours pass like moments.
Some doors should be opened slowly.

events.text: There are fewer people who can stand across from you now. Some days you miss losing.

effects.log: A long search, a good fight, a friend.

choices.text: Teach until your students can challenge you

effects.log: A slower path, and a better one.

events.text: At dawn, you feel heaven and earth move as one in your meridians.

effects.log: A thread of the Way.
Your notes will guide others for centuries.

events.text: Your hair has stopped greying. Your old friends have not.

effects.log: Their grandchildren call you venerable elder.
Time is a debt that can be delayed.

events.text: A village near your hermitage tells stories about you. Most of them are wrong.

effects.log: The true stories are stranger.
You become a local god. They leave rice at your door.

events.text: You dream of thunder breaking over your head, and wake calm.

effects.log: Something is coming. You will be ready.
Dreams are dreams.

events.text: You catch a falling leaf with only your intent. It hangs in the air.

effects.log: Power used for nothing is still power.
The child keeps the leaf forever.
